data.answer: This query lists the repository-relative path of every non-test Python file that no other file in the repository imports. It reads the file inventory and excludes package initializer files, main-entry files, and anything under the Alembic migration directory, then keeps only files that never appear as the resolved target of an import made by a different file. Self-imports and imports that do not resolve to a tracked file are not counted, while directly-run scripts are still eligible to be listed. Results are returned as distinct paths in alphabetical order.

display_annotations.note: Deterministic display links; not source citations made by the model.

data.question: Which non-test modules are never imported by another file in the repository? Leave out package __init__.py files, __main__.py files and the Alembic migration directory.
data.reference_sql:
SELECT f.file_id
FROM code.files f
WHERE NOT f.is_test
  AND right('/' || f.file_id, 12) NOT IN ('/__init__.py', '/__main__.py')
  AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'alembic/%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i
    WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id AND i.file_id <> f.file_id
  )
ORDER BY f.file_id;

request.evidence: Only imports that resolve to a file count. Python runs a package's __init__.py whenever a submodule is imported; __main__.py files are run with python -m or as a console script (the code map holds only Python files, so pyproject [project.scripts] entries are not read; at this commit the only one, in mcp/pyproject.toml, points at a __main__.py); Alembic loads alembic/ from its script_location. Scripts run directly by path, such as files under dev_tools/, are still listed.
request.question:
Which non-test modules are never imported by another file in the repository? Leave out package __init__.py files, __main__.py files and the Alembic migration directory.

Requested output columns: file_id (string).
Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. Describe what the query computes and the assumptions it makes; the returned rows are reported separately. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. Use DOUBLE or DECIMAL, rather than single-precision REAL, for percentage calculations.

data.sql: SELECT f.file_id FROM code.files AS f WHERE f.is_test = FALSE AND f.file_id <> '__init__.py' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE '%/__init__.py' AND f.file_id <> '__main__.py' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE '%/__main__.py' AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'alembic/%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports AS i WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id AND i.file_id <> f.file_id) ORDER BY f.file_id;
